sentences.en: Over the past several months, the United States has been giving Ukraine a steady stream of intelligence to aid them in the war against Russia.
sentences.zh: 在过去的几个月里，美国一直在向乌克兰提供源源不断的情报，以协助他们抗击俄罗斯。

sentences.en: But what is becoming clear is that the Ukrainians are not returning the favor.
sentences.zh: 但越来越明显的是，乌克兰人并没有礼尚往来。

sentences.en: Today, national security reporter Julian Barnes on what the Ukrainians are not telling the Americans and what that might mean for the future of the war.
sentences.zh: 今天，国家安全记者朱利安·巴恩斯将为我们解读乌克兰人隐瞒了美国什么，以及这可能对这场战争的未来意味着什么。

sentences.en: It's Monday, June 13th.
sentences.zh: 今天是6月13日，星期一。

sentences.en: So, Julian, you cover the American intelligence agencies, and recently you've been reporting on the war in Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 朱利安，你负责报道美国情报机构，最近你一直在报道乌克兰战争。

sentences.en: So, tell me what you've been finding.
sentences.zh: 那么，告诉我们你发现了什么。

sentences.en: This is such an unusual war.
sentences.zh: 这是一场非常寻常的战争。

sentences.en: It's really different than conflicts we've seen in the past for the main reason that we have a huge amount of information.
sentences.zh: 它确实不同于我们过去见过的冲突，主要原因是我们拥有海量的信息。

sentences.en: We have daily press briefings from the United States and the UK talking about the movements of Russian troops.
sentences.zh: 我们有美国和英国的每日新闻发布会，讨论俄罗斯军队的动向。

sentences.en: We have think tanks producing reports on what they are seeing on the ground.
sentences.zh: 我们有智库发布关于他们在地面上看到的情况的报告。

sentences.en: And we have an explosion of commercial satellite imagery that can show you the movements of Russian troops, their advances, their fallbacks.
sentences.zh: 还有爆发式的商业卫星图像，可以向你展示俄军的动向、推进和撤退。

sentences.en: And, of course, there's also the social media aspect.
sentences.zh: 当然，还有社交媒体这一块。

sentences.en: And there are lots of images of Ukrainians firing anti-tank missiles and exploding Russian armor.
sentences.zh: 有大量乌克兰人发射反坦克导弹和炸毁俄军装甲的画面。

sentences.en: Yeah, you feel like you're there with these things, right?
sentences.zh: 是的，你会觉得你就和他们在一起，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah, you do.
sentences.zh: 是的，确实如此。

sentences.en: And you really feel like you can understand the war.
sentences.zh: 你真的觉得自己能看懂这场战争。

sentences.en: But as I was looking at this, you know, I became uncomfortable, nervous that I was getting an incomplete picture.
sentences.zh: 但当我看着这些时，你知道，我开始感到不安，担心自己得到的画面并不完整。

sentences.en: You know, what we are all seeing is Ukrainian success, these great victories by an undermanned military.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们所有人看到的都是乌克兰的成功，是这支人手不足的军队取得的伟大胜利。

sentences.en: The Ukrainian army that none of us would have known or thought would be that strategic or prepared has been remarkably effective against a much bigger, much more mighty army.
sentences.zh: 这支我们谁也没想到会如此具有战略眼光或准备充分的乌克兰军队，面对一支规模大得多、强大得多的军队，表现得极其高效。

sentences.en: They were the little engine that could.
sentences.zh: 他们就像那列自信能行的火车头。

sentences.en: Improbable victory after improbable victory.
sentences.zh: 一次又一次不可思议的胜利。

sentences.en: And at the same time...
sentences.zh: 与此同时……

sentences.en: The U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: says it has evidence that this invasion has been a strategic disaster for Russia.
sentences.zh: 称其有证据表明，这场入侵对俄罗斯来说是一场战略灾难。

sentences.en: We were seeing this image of failure on the Russian side.
sentences.zh: 我们看到了俄方失败的画面。

sentences.en: A 40-mile-long Russian convoy headed to the capital, Kiev, appeared to stall Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 一支长达40英里的俄罗斯车队驶向首都基辅，周二似乎陷入了停滞。

sentences.en: Long logistics trains...
sentences.zh: 漫长的后勤车队……

sentences.en: Parts of the convoy reportedly running out of gas and food.
sentences.zh: 据报道，车队的某些部分耗尽了燃料和食物。

sentences.en: Massive casualties...
sentences.zh: 巨大的伤亡……

sentences.en: Russian military casualties are reportedly mounting as ground advances slow.
sentences.zh: 据报道，随着地面推进放缓，俄军伤亡人数正在不断上升。

sentences.en: Captured soldiers, combat losses...
sentences.zh: 被俘士兵、战斗损失……

sentences.en: Russia's iconic warship, the Moskva, sank yesterday.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯的标志性军舰“莫斯科”号昨天沉没了。

sentences.en: Russia suffered a big loss here when Ukraine destroyed a pontoon bridge...
sentences.zh: 乌克兰摧毁了一座浮桥，俄罗斯在这里遭受了重大损失……

sentences.en: A military that didn't know how to fight.
sentences.zh: 一支不懂得如何战斗的军队。

sentences.en: British officials say it's another sign that Russia's war has gone awry.
sentences.zh: 英国官员表示，这是俄罗斯战争走向出错的又一个迹象。

sentences.en: In some ways, we hear a lot more about Ukrainian successes and Russian failures than we do the opposite.
sentences.zh: 在某些方面，我们听到的关于乌克兰成功和俄罗斯失败的消息远多于相反的情况。

sentences.en: And a lot of that has to do with the kind of information and really the lack of information that we're getting from the Ukrainian side.
sentences.zh: 这很大程度上与我们从乌克兰方面获得的信息种类以及实际上信息的缺乏有关。

sentences.en: It's so interesting hearing you say this, Julian, because I remember noticing that same pattern when I was in Ukraine all those weeks, that, you know, we would get a press release
sentences.zh: 听到你这么说真是有趣，朱利安，因为我记得在乌克兰呆的那些周里，我也注意到了同样的模式，你知道，我们会收到一份

sentences.en: from the Russian Ministry of Defense and we would look at it and say, well, obviously, that's not right.
sentences.zh: 来自俄罗斯国防部的新闻稿，我们看了看会说，好吧，显然，那是不对的。

sentences.en: You know, we can't really use that.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们真的不能用那个。

sentences.en: But then we get a press release from the Ukrainian Ministry of Defense.
sentences.zh: 但接着我们会收到一份来自乌克兰国防部的新闻稿。

sentences.en: And we'd also think, hold on a second, that's not right either.
sentences.zh: 我们也会想，等一下，那也不对。

sentences.en: So I remember feeling very frustrated at the official information coming out of Ukraine in a lot of ways to be able to say what's going on out there.
sentences.zh: 所以我记得对乌克兰发布的官方信息感到非常沮丧，在很多方面都无法说清到底外面发生了什么。

sentences.en: You know, it was hard to tell.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这很难分辨。

sentences.en: It's interesting that you say that.

sentences.en: I sat down with Mason Clark of the Institute for the Study of War.
sentences.zh: 我采访了战争研究所的梅森·克拉克。

sentences.en: That's a Washington think tank that has done really important work on the Ukraine invasion.
sentences.zh: 那是华盛顿的一个智库，在乌克兰入侵问题上做过非常重要的工作。

sentences.en: They make the maps the New York Times uses to track the invasion.
sentences.zh: 他们制作了《纽约时报》用来追踪入侵的地图。

sentences.en: Oh, interesting.
sentences.zh: 哦，有意思。

sentences.en: And they look at social media posts.
sentences.zh: 他们查看社交媒体帖子。

sentences.en: They look at satellite imagery.
sentences.zh: 他们查看卫星图像。

sentences.en: But they also look at those press releases that you talked about.
sentences.zh: 但他们也查看你刚才提到的那些新闻稿。

sentences.en: And Mason told me that once the city in Ukraine stops getting mentioned in one of these press releases after a few days,
sentences.zh: 梅森告诉我，一旦乌克兰的一个城市在几天后不再出现在这些新闻稿中，

sentences.en: that's a bad sign.
sentences.zh: 那就是一个不好的信号。

sentences.en: And he kind of makes a mark as possible loss of territory.
sentences.zh: 他会将其标记为可能失去的领土。

sentences.en: It's not definitive information, but it's evident.
sentences.zh: 这不是决定性的信息，但它是一个迹象。

sentences.en: And the bottom line here is that Kyiv touts its victories, but is silent on its losses.
sentences.zh: 这里的底线是，基辅大肆宣扬其胜利，但对失败却保持沉默。

sentences.zh: 那么朱利安，作为一名记者，

sentences.en: and I started asking the same question about this imperfect information.
